rules.rule: Any code that moves money or changes account state must write a structured audit event via AuditLogger with request ID and actor.
Never swallow exceptions. Failures must be logged and surfaced to the caller as an error result.
Never log card numbers, account numbers, tokens or PII. Use the redacting logger.
A loan disbursement must verify that the loan is in APPROVED status before any funds move. Reject or fail the disbursement for any other status.
Monetary amounts use the Money value type. Flag Double, Float or bare BigDecimal used as an amount.
